summary: claimEpic, storeEpic, failEpic with lock-then-read, 60s lease and versioned epic rows; E22-E25, E27 plus E51 view additions pass on the real database.

produces.name: claimEpic
produces.note: CLAIMED | DONE; NOT_FOUND for non-creator or bad index; CONFLICT_STATE for live lease or non-PENDING proposal

produces.name: storeEpic
produces.note: throws CONFLICT_STATE when proposal not PENDING or claimedVersion stale; flagged sets proposal.flagged without version change

produces.name: failEpic
produces.note: same guards, returns quietly when they fail
